title: REQ · GameLayout exposes an optional header slot rendered as a compact overlay in the game area
summary: GameLayout accepts an optional header ReactNode and renders it inside the main game area.
description: Context: GameLayout in game/frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx takes only scene and story. Desired behavior: add an optional header prop rendered inside the relatively-positioned main element so HeaderOverlay (absolute, top) overlays the game. Expected result: header content shows in the game area, and layouts without a header are unchanged. Why: App needs a slot to host the header.
acceptance_criteria: Given a header prop, when GameLayout renders, then the header node is a descendant of the main element
Given no header prop, when GameLayout renders, then it renders exactly as before with scene and story
Given the header slot, when rendered, then the story aside does not contain the header

preserve: Existing grid, drawer toggle and aria-expanded behavior

technical_constraints: Tailwind classes only; main already has relative positioning
definition_of_done: GameLayout renders header slot; layout tests pass
